title: Sustainable Financing Partnership
summary: MBRHE reports that AI credit and eligibility models automate housing-loan assessment and remove manual approval bottlenecks. AI’s separate effect is unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MBRHE reports that AI models evaluate housing-loan eligibility and priority using credit, income and social criteria. It identifies logistic regression, decision trees and ensemble models trained with historical approvals and credit-bureau data. The models are described as removing manual approval bottlenecks within a service integrated with Emirates Islamic Bank. Full deployment is dated to Q1 2025. Bank financing, interest subsidies, APIs and digital identity also contribute to the overall program. Its loan volume, budget savings and workload totals do not isolate the models’ contribution.
purpose: Reduce manual work and delays in housing-loan eligibility assessment.
system: MBRHE AI housing-loan credit and eligibility assessment
deployer: Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment and Emirates Islamic Bank

ratings.reason: MBRHE reports that AI automates credit and eligibility evaluation and removes manual approval bottlenecks. AI’s share of the wider program’s reported 30% workload reduction is unknown.
MBRHE reports that automated eligibility evaluation helps applicants move through approval more quickly. Changes in household welfare attributable to the models are unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: Trained credit and social-vulnerability models automate eligibility assessment. MBRHE reports fewer manual approval bottlenecks. AI’s effect is not separated from financing and workflow changes.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 8 Sustainable Financing Partnership

produced_by: Credit-risk and eligibility models integrated into housing-loan assessment
must_hold: Historical approvals, credit-bureau information, income and social-eligibility data
Bank-system APIs and digital identity access integrated with the eligibility workflow

headline: AI assesses housing-loan eligibility in Dubai
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
